messages:
Mira (PM): quick thread — finalizing the launch-gate matrix for 'tenant hot cache'. sketched gates: alpha/beta/ga. can each team drop the single must-have to clear beta?
Jon (Eng): eng must-have = per-tenant toggle + API throttling. without per-tenant opt-out we can't protect noisy tenants. need deterministic model pin for canaries too.
Priya (Runtime): runtime must-have = transparent cache-warm migration or read-through fallback. if we can't warm prefixes quickly, p95 will spike and break SLA. request a 24h rollback window to rehydrate caches if hotfix needed.
Diego (Infra): infra must-have = scheduled prewarm reservations and a burst SLO for the beta cohort. need confirmed GPU reservations and a small host quota increase; plan for cross-region failover for private tenants.
Nadia (Security): security must-have = exportable audit trail for cache access + a brief threat-model addendum for tenant-prefetch. ensure in-transit encryption for any backfill.
Kai (SRE): sre must-have = automated circuit breaker that flips on error-rate or sustained p95 above threshold; playbook to disable cache at edge; synthetic monitors for tenant burst profiles.
Mira (PM): thanks. follow-ups: 1) beta acceptance test (one-liner)? 2) owner confirmation.
Jon (Eng): acceptance test = run 10 tenants in parallel with mixed prompt shapes for 60m; verify per-tenant p95 < 400ms and error rate < 0.5%. owner = Jon (Eng) ok.
Priya (Runtime): acceptance test = end-to-end run with seeded KV backfill during a 48h window; p95 degradation <= 1.15x baseline. owner = Priya (Runtime) ok.
Diego (Infra): acceptance test = 30m prewarm sim at 2x expected beta QPS with failover test. owner = Diego (Infra) ok (will post reservation ETA).
Nadia (Security): acceptance test = export + tamper-check on sample tenant audit and review threat-model addendum. owner = Nadia (Security) ok.
Kai (SRE): acceptance test = execute canary ramp and circuit-breaker tests; run synthetic burst monitors. owner = Kai (SRE) ok.
Mira (PM): adding a 'hotfix constraints' column. one-line entries please.
Jon (Eng): hotfix constraint = admin feature-flag to disable prefetch per-tenant + fast global throttle toggle.
Priya (Runtime): hotfix constraint = read-through fallback toggled without cache invalidation; graceful degrade to on-demand token path.
Diego (Infra): hotfix constraint = ability to scale prewarm pool down instantly and migrate traffic to fallback region within 5m.
Nadia (Security): hotfix constraint = emergency revocation of prefetch credentials and audit snapshot.
Kai (SRE): hotfix constraint = runbook with rollback script and one-click toggles in ops-console.
Mira (PM): final ask — risk level (low/med/high) for beta given current blockers. i'll compile into roadmap doc.
Jon (Eng): risk = med (toggle + pin doable in 2 sprints).
Priya (Runtime): risk = med-high (backfill timing uncertain; need test window).
Diego (Infra): risk = med (reservations pending finance sign-off).
Nadia (Security): risk = low-med (docs mostly ready; residency checks pending for private tenants).
Kai (SRE): risk = med (circuit-breaker automation halfway done).
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder — create ticket T-1124 in launches board and link the matrix doc when available :pushpin:
Mira (PM): thanks team — i'll post the matrix and proposed canary schedule by EOD PT. comment on the doc or ping me for edits. :calendar:
